_what: Ceilings that may only ever go DOWN. Raising one is allowed exactly once per deliberate decision, in its own commit, with the reason in the message.
_measured_at: 2026-09-18: 7496 -> 7502, deliberately and once, hours after the previous raise and for the half it missed. 2026.38 gave the retry ladder a budget and ended the standing order when the budget refused — but only at the ladder. _tryHealStation asks the same question one guard earlier and answered it with a bare return, and THAT is the branch the default configuration takes: address healing is on out of the box, so a listener who unticks the retry switch never reaches the ladder. The order stayed up with no timer under it and the next reachability edge handed a long-dead station to netResumeTimer — issue #13 verbatim, under the setting offered as its cure. The teardown now lives in one _orderSpent() that both refusals call, which is the same medicine _mayKnock was for the switch. Ceiling = wc -l package/contents/ui/main.qml
_how_to_remeasure: direct_exec:      grep -rhoE 'executable\.exec\(' package --include='*.qml' | wc -l   (then subtract the facade's own body — tests/test_ratchet.py does that part)
